verdict.rationale:
Cognee supports natural-language interaction via `.recall()` (auto-classifies query intent), a CLI that lets users "remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions" from the terminal, and an MCP server that lets natural-language AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline) issue commands directly. This covers query, ingestion, and management operations through conversational/natural-language interfaces across multiple surfaces (CLI, MCP, recall auto-routing).
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of a natural-language session actually working, and no example transcripts showing free-form command parsing beyond documented API/CLI wrappers.
